description: You enter the inner mechanisms of a titanic mechanical typewriter. Gigantic metallic key rods extend upward like building columns, vibrating with dangerous high-voltage static charge. High-frequency crackles echo all around you.

iron_wall.description: Thick iron plating that forms the chassis of the typewriter. Impassable.

key_floor.description: Solid steel plating between the key mechanisms.

exit_south.description: The heavy metal key leading back south to Textlandia Road.

exit_north.description: A dark, oily gap leading north to the ink ribbons.

shock_key.effectMessage: ZAP! The typewriter key discharges a static shock directly into your sole!
shock_key.description: A massive circular typewriter key cap. It hums with blue static electricity and looks highly volatile.
